name: Fat Pack | 4g Prepackaged Flower | Mocha Runtz
description: Fat Pack: The Original 4 Gram Eighth – a half gram better. Mocha Runtz, bred from Lemon Cherry Gelato BX2, is a balanced hybrid with euphoric cerebral effects and mellow body relaxation. Its coffee-chocolate aroma with sweet, creamy undertones is enhanced by Caryophyllene, Limonene, and Linalool. Both flavorful and smooth, it’s great for day or night.
